purpose: Implement exactly one deterministic metadata-only Binance USD-M historical archive probe for later separately authorized public_research execution. This task must not access the network or market data.

known_local_inventory_finding.legacy_h1_block: SC001_C12_D3_H1_BODY_INTEGRITY contains USDC-USDT trade archives 2025-01-01 through 2025-07-01 and is not the target multi-asset 1m-kline backbone
known_local_inventory_finding.interpretation: Do not infer source absence globally; this is only the current local legacy inventory result.

implementation_contract.candidate_symbol_rule: Discover CommonPrefixes under root_prefix; retain only symbols matching ^[A-Z0-9]+USDT$; sort UTF-8 bytewise/ASCII lexicographically.
implementation_contract.h1_scan_rule: Scan candidates in frozen lexicographic order until exactly 12 symbols with >=300 calendar days covered by one contiguous run of complete monthly 1m ZIP archive keys ending no later than 2026-09 are found, or until 80 candidates have been scanned. Do not use price/volume/returns or file size to choose symbols.
implementation_contract.h1_universe_rule: The first 12 qualifying symbols are the frozen H1 candidate universe. If fewer than 6 qualify within the bounded scan, terminal status is insufficient. If 6-11 qualify, retain exactly those; do not expand the scan beyond 80 in the same version.
implementation_contract.anchor_rule: Always probe BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT separately for X1 source-class compatibility; report whether each has a contiguous >=36 complete-month archive run ending no later than 2026-09. This does not freeze the full X1 PIT universe.
object_metadata_fields_allowed: source URL derived mechanically from key
implementation_contract.self_test_scope: Synthetic XML fixtures only; prove S3 pagination/delimiter parsing, monthly-key parsing, contiguous-month/day computation, lexicographic first-12 rule, 80-candidate cap, BTC/ETH anchor checks, request/byte caps. No network.

terminal_rule: Persist exactly exact_implementation_path, verify readback/hash and current main, then write one terminal receipt with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false. Do not run the self-test or network probe in this task.
next_after_pass: Strategy Control/Manager static-review and merge; run one offline synthetic self-test from canonical main; if PASS, issue exact T1 authorization binding the implementation hash for one public_research metadata-only qualification run.
